reason: I want to build the press, and carving planks seems like a useful first step toward its parts.
expectation: I expect a shaped wooden component, though its exact role is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water might make ink for the pages, but building the press comes first.

effect: The carved planks became a printing block, which can now be combined with iron.
reaction: A printing block makes sense for illustrated pages, though I had expected a press component.
reason: Combining the block with iron may build the press or one of its parts.
expectation: I expect a printing press or a component of one, though the iron's exact role is unclear.

alternatives.reason: Charcoal and water may make ink, but I want to pursue the press first.

effect: The block and iron made the press; its screw mechanism explains how it presses paper onto an inked block. The next goal is to print a page.
reaction: The explanation of the screw and plate made the press satisfying to understand.
reason: Charcoal and water may make the ink needed to print.
expectation: I expect ink, though I don't know whether it will need further preparation.

alternatives.reason: Placing paper at the press also seems necessary, but I want to prepare ink first.

effect: Charcoal and water made the expected ink, ready for the press.
reaction: The result was predictable and useful.
reason: Placing the ink at the press seems like a practical step toward printing the page.
expectation: I expect the ink to be placed at the press, ready for printing.

alternatives.reason: Paper also needs to reach the press, but I chose to place the ink first.

effect: The ink is at the press, and paper can now be combined with it there.
reason: Combining paper with the ink at the press should advance the goal of printing a page.
expectation: I expect a printed page, though it may need another step.

effect: The paper and ink produced printed pages, completing the chapter and showing how the block repeats the same words and pictures.
reaction: The result was satisfying, though expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the press was most worthwhile because the explanation made its screw and plate mechanism clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the ink was a straightforward preparation with little to decide.

surprise.text: I expected a press component from carving the planks, but got a printing block for the illustrated pages.

arbitrary.text: None felt especially arbitrary; the available combinations had a plausible purpose.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see more explanations of how things work, though the offered combinations made the decisions fairly straightforward.
